content.title: Hit Korean Boxing Drama ‘Bloodhounds’ Back in Action for Season 2 -  About Netflix
content.text: Entertainment15 January 2025GlobalSouth KoreaThe production and cast of Bloodhounds Season 2 have been announced, bringing back your favorite boxing duo with a fresh twist — a new villain. After dismantling a heinous loan shark ring, Gun-woo (Woo Do-hwan) and Woo-jin (Lee Sang-yi) are set to land another exhilarating straight hook, this time against a global underground boxing league led by Baek-jeong (Jung Ji-hoon).Based on the webtoon of the same name, the first season of Bloodhounds ranked in the Top 10 across 83 countries following its release in June 2023. Fans worldwide loved the teamwork and spirit shared by the courageous pair, Gun-woo and Woo-jin.In season 2, Woo Do-hwan (Mr. Plankton, The King: Eternal Monarch) returns as Gun-woo, who embodies the righteous “heart of a boxer.” Lee Sang-yi (My Demon, No Gain No Love) reprises his role as Woo-jin, Gun-woo’s bold and brave friend and fellow boxer. Together, they reunite to take down an illegal boxing league. Jung Ji-hoon (Take 1, Red Swan) steps into his first villain role as Baek-jeong, who uses his power and any means necessary to draw Gun-woo and Woo-jin into the underground boxing world.Get ready for another action-packed adventure with Bloodhounds Season 2, only on Netflix.Title Information Title: Bloodhounds Season 2 Director/Writer: Kim Joo-hwan Cast: Woo Do-hwan, Lee Sang-yi, Jung Ji-hoon Production: Studio N Co-Production: Seven O Six, Ghost Studio Based on: Naver Webtoon Series Bloodhounds by Jeong ChanMore Company News
